'''2007 Illinois State Championship Mike Kalmbach LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Kalmbach]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Light side
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
